scope.outcome_definition: slope of the luminous leading-edge position against time, frozen window rule (R-W4)
scope.target_context: another BASS-II thin-PMMA run, held out from the source
prohibited_uses: extrapolation to other fuels, geometries or gravity levels without evidence
claim that gravity alone caused an observed difference

run_identity.pass_when: Both runs are identified by NASA proof sheet against the stills used.

observable_equivalence.pass_when: Both rates come from the same frozen rule and reference definition.

material_geometry.pass_when: Same material named in the record and same thickness; a thickness difference passes only as a bridged partial via thin-fuel 1/thickness scaling (CRAM-1).

atmosphere_flow.pass_when: Oxygen within 0.5 percentage points; flow levels both inside the thermal regime (CRAM-2).

regime_validity.pass_when: Both runs classified thermal, not transitional, by CRAM-2.

boundary_conditions.pass_when: Same sample width and flow restrictor.

measurement_reconstruction.pass_when: Both runs have a fitted segment under the frozen rule.

uncertainty_and_reproducibility.pass_when: Statistical and analyst-choice layers reported and physical unknowns bounded; with unbounded unknowns at most partial.

domain_statement.pass_when: The domain of the conclusion is stated.

case_rules.effect: Run identity requires the proof-sheet match (RES-035, RES-036).
Rates under different rules or reference definitions are not the same observable (RES-039).
A material not named in the record is inferred, never matched (ISS-011, ISS-051).
Thickness differences are bridged only by the thin-fuel 1/thickness scaling, as a bounded assumption.
Oxygen differences above 0.5 percentage points block quantitative transfer.
Runs in different regimes are not pooled; transitional runs give at most a partial gate.
Width and flow restrictor must match for a passing boundary gate.
An unbounded physical unknown (luminous-edge offset) keeps the uncertainty gate partial.

decision_policy.conflict_semantics: An unresolved source conflict is an evidence problem, not automatically a physical incompatibility.
decision_policy.statistic_semantics: A maximum and a mean are not equivalent statistics. A request to treat them as an equivalent quantitative pair is not transferable on current evidence.
decision_policy.conflict_scope: An unresolved conflict blocks only an inference whose required gates overlap the conflict's affects_gates. If affects_gates is absent or empty, the conflict is conservatively treated as relevant to every inference.
